purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove association grant eligibility, amount, deadline, open application or payment.

mappings.product_miss: The shared person pilot already accepted actor_type=association but still asked association versus company again and then returned one static sports-heavy result bundle for associations and small companies regardless of funding, facility or procurement need. This created redundant questioning, false-positive LOK/RF suggestions for non-sports associations, association support leakage into company journeys and Swedish-only result explanations after Arabic or Persian selection.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep one product and the existing org flow. Reuse known association actor context, split results by already-selected organisation type and need, route companies back to the existing company pilot, use municipal/MUCF/Arvsfonden/foundation sources as distinct discovery families, mark Stiftelsesök as discovery rather than open-call proof, keep RF facility support explicitly conditional, and localize the result explanations without changing source truth.
